do_not_use_when: the text has no blank-line paragraph breaks (lists, transcripts, single-block exports)
you want a calibrated AI/human verdict; the band thresholds are heuristic
house style or a copyedit legitimately regularized paragraphs (see confounder_audit)

examples.description: Paragraph rhythm against a personal baseline

purpose: Paragraph-level distributional diagnostic for "competent rectangle" paragraphing. Reports paragraph length distribution and variance, first- vs body-sentence length ratio, punchy-ending and one-sentence-paragraph rates, long-paragraph clustering, and opening/closing typologies, with a provisional Lightly / Moderately / Heavily smoothed band and optional baseline z-scores. Emits structural metrics only, no raw text.
use_when: sentence- and token-level Layer A signals look normal but the draft reads as uniformly paragraphed
comparing a draft's paragraph rhythm against the writer's own baseline (--baseline-dir)
you need a paragraph-rhythm report that is safe to share (no raw text)
